coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Cenxi local real-estate registration and cadastral records are administered through the county-level registration authority under Guangxi/China rules; this is administrative evidence, not proof of an open geospatial endpoint.

registryBasis: An official Guangxi Natural Resources land-use approval names Cenxi and states that, after lawful land acquisition, the real-estate registration institution handles collective-land ownership cancellation or change. Guangxi's official registration entry point and policy pages document local/county registration procedures and cadastral-information governance. No public Cenxi map/API was established.
